integrity: The lower witness is checked directly from the descendant definition. The upper bound is an exhaustive symmetry-complete search implemented in two traversal styles; finite verification is used only for this finite parameter.
limitations: The theorem is a finite exact result for the ternary length-four, coalition-two parameter; the upper bound is computer-assisted and does not extend to a general alphabet-size formula.
title: Exact ternary length-four 2-frameproof code size
